name: Google Meet
description: Google Meet is Google's video meeting service for real-time collaboration. Individuals and teams use it to create secure meeting spaces and join calls from the web or Google Workspace.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Google account through Relay-owned OAuth, then let agents use four bounded wrappers to read one explicit app-created Space, prepare safe configuration locally, create a moderated restricted or trusted Space, and patch one app-created Space with a forced safety update mask. Relay V1 excludes open or unmoderated settings, conference termination, participant and attendance data, conference records, recordings, transcripts, smart notes, Drive artifacts, dial-in and SIP details, events, media, hardware, broad Meet or Drive scopes, pagination, delegation, and raw tools.

blocked.label: End active conference
blocked.description: Active-conference termination is blocked in V1.

blocked.label: Use open or unmoderated meeting settings
blocked.description: Open access, moderation off, unrestricted participant features, attendance, and automatic artifacts are blocked.

blocked.label: Access meeting participants
blocked.description: Participant identities, attendance, devices, and participant sessions are outside V1.

blocked.label: Access conference records
blocked.description: Conference record identifiers and lifecycle data are outside V1.

blocked.label: Access meeting artifacts
blocked.description: Recordings, transcripts, smart notes, Drive files, dial-in, and SIP details are outside V1.

blocked.label: Use Meet events, media, or hardware APIs
blocked.description: Events, media streams, eCDN, hardware, and add-on surfaces are outside V1.

blocked.label: Use broad Meet or Drive scopes
blocked.description: Broader Meet and restricted recording or transcript Drive scopes are forbidden.

blocked.label: Run raw or delegated Meet access
blocked.description: Raw endpoints, automatic pagination, service accounts, and domain delegation are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Explicit app-created Space reads and local preparation run automatically; safe create and patch require matching approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All four selected tools run without Relay per-action approval while exact app-created scope, moderated configuration, privacy redaction, audit, refresh, revocation, and provider limits remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts four safe app-created Google Meet Space wrappers and attaches encrypted OAuth tokens server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay must configure its Google Cloud project and confidential web client, enable Google Meet REST API, publish its OAuth consent screen with verified relayconsole.work domains and policy links, complete Google's applicable verification for the sensitive app-created Space scope, configure Railway staging credentials, confirm Workspace entitlement and admin policy, and authorize an acceptance account. Those provider-console and environment actions are outside this worker task.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task, configure the canonical Railway callback and exact scope, complete Google verification, configure staging credentials, then verify all four tools, app-created ownership, safe configuration and redaction, Safe and Dangerous policy, refresh, rotation, revocation, disconnect, Workspace policy, quota/error mapping, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Google documents the narrow meetings.space.created OAuth scope for spaces created by an app and broader scopes Relay excludes.
Spaces.create uses Meet API v2 and accepts a Space body under the app-created Space scope.
Spaces.get retrieves one explicit Space resource.
Spaces.patch updates one exact Space using an explicit update mask.
Space configuration includes access, entry-point, moderation, attendance, and artifact settings plus sensitive conference, phone, and SIP fields Relay excludes.
Google documents separate Meet read, write, and reduced-create quotas and 429 rate-limit behavior.
